cases.subject: Gold fleet card: free fuel for three months
cases.body:
Dear Customer,

Paliwa-Flota Billing Department is delighted to invite your company to a new loyalty program called Gold Fleet. Every company that joins this week receives three months of free fuel for two vehicles, a discount of 20 cents per litre for the remaining fleet, and a free upgrade of every card to the new Gold level with higher monthly limits, free roadside help and insurance for drivers.

How does it work? You only need to open the secure panel with the button in this message, confirm the company profile, name the authorised person and enter the tax number and the bank account to which we should send the monthly rebate. The procedure takes about two minutes, and our system activates the program automatically after you finish. More than three hundred fleet companies already joined and many of them reported savings of several thousand zloty each month.

The program is open only for 48 hours, and the number of Gold cards is limited. After this time the offer is withdrawn and profiles without confirmation are closed. We also ask you not to contact your account manager about this program, because the offer is processed only by our central billing team and he has no access to it. Please do not forward this message to other persons.

Regards | Paliwa-Flota Billing Department
